answer_1.quote: We evaluate all models by manually annotating their responses on XSTEST... We test the state-of-the-art LLMs ... using safe and unsafe prompts.
answer_1.outputs: Model responses to safe and unsafe prompts (full compliance, full refusal, partial refusal)

answer_2.quote: We also explore two automated evaluation methods for classifying model responses on XSTEST.

answer_3.quote: We also use GPT-4, prompted with the taxonomy laid out in §4.2, to classify responses as full compliance, full refusal, or partial refusal, in a zero-shot setup.

answer_4.quote: All annotations were completed by three authors of this paper, with two annotations per prompt. ... We differentiate between three primary types of responses: Full Compliance, Full Refusal, Partial Refusal.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators classified each model response according to a taxonomy of Full Compliance, Full Refusal, and Partial Refusal.
